The '''''Aurora''''' was a large [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Tanker/Legends|fuel tanker]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was commanded by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Separatist [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jorm]].

==Description==
The ''Aurora'' had an assemblage of oval fuel tanks where multiple [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] could dock for refueling.

==History==
During the war, the ''Aurora'' was assaulted by several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] in a mock attack meant to lure out the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]''. The vessel was then infiltrated by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team which prompted the battleship to send a shuttle of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] to clear them out. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were dismantled and used as covers by the Jedi, who then proceeded to infiltrate what they thought was the ''Starcrusher''. The ''Aurora'' then departed the system.
